key_insight: Many neural networks that look like the same solution in loss space can hide very different internal computations, and Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC) can traverse these connected low-loss regions to reveal and steer that diversity.
engineering_relevance: HNC gives engineers a practical way to explore, compare, merge, and edit trained models while preserving performance, with implications for interpretability, fine-tuning, and AI safety auditing.
method: Uses local Hessian curvature to move within the null space of the loss landscape.
Traverses low-loss, mode-connected regions while maintaining task behavior.
Steers the walk toward solutions with specified properties to probe functional diversity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful tests on RNN memory tasks, ImageNet-trained Vision Transformers, reinforcement-learning agents, and an AI Safety Gridworld, showing preserved performance alongside markedly different representations, dynamics, and strategies.
watch_item: Because HNC relies on local curvature information and task-specific low-loss connectivity, its behavior may depend on model scale, optimization state, and how accurately the Hessian structure is estimated.
paper_title: Traversing the solution space of neural networks with Hessian Null Space Continuation
